newsitem.title: USA: Centennial says Quad debt satisfied.
newsitem.headline: Centennial says Quad debt satisfied.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc said late Wednesday that all of the account receivable obligations it had with Quad Systems Corp were 'satisfied.'
"If they (Quad) are going to report a loss, it won't be because of us," Centennial spokeswoman Cherly Byrne said,
Earlier Wednesday, Quad said its second-quarter earnings might be set back by $0.11 per share it could not collect about $750,000 owed by Centennial.

Centennial faces a slew of shareholder lawsuits filed after it said it would restate its results for fiscal 1996 and the first quarter of 1997 and revise its second-quarter 1997 results to show a loss.
Quad said it might also go into credit default if it could not collect Centennial's obligations.
